#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pull the newest CI logs so flaky tests can be diffed locally."""
import argparse
import pathlib

import paramiko

HOST = "ci-box.example.net"


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--last", type=int, default=1)
    args = p.parse_args()
    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
    client.load_system_host_keys()
    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    client.connect(HOST, username="dev")
    _, out, _ = client.exec_command(f"ls -t /var/ci/logs | head -{args.last}")
    sftp = client.open_sftp()
    dest = pathlib.Path("build/ci-logs")
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in out.read().decode().split():
        sftp.get(f"/var/ci/logs/{name}", str(dest / name))
        print("fetched", name)
    client.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
